findings.text: _arm re-implements the per-arm summary the repository already owns at scripts/prototypes/diiid_forward_convergence/build_receipt.py:29 _arm_summary (same residual_history/mask_history projection), without importing or extending it.

_trips records only active_cells and residual per trip, so the done_when's per-trip axis Z, confined current and net vertical force (or radial field at the current centroid) are carried only as terminal scalars; the manifest's rubric.trajectory concedes the substitution.

FRAMES omits frame 144, yet the fragment's mechanism section (docs/evidence/fragments/diiid-vertical-force-balance/diiid-frame-146-vertical-loss.html:121) and the manifest's discriminator rest on frame-144 amplitude 0.929 Wb / 25.28x ratio that no committed artefact reproduces.

done_when item 3 asks for a line-contour panel of each trip that matters; the landed figures are terminal-state panels only (section 'Terminal states side by side'), which the manifest records as an admitted deviation because the source probe saved no per-trip grids.
